data.why: The repo ships examples/sample_aoi.geojson, a small ~5km x 5km AOI near Lingchuan County used by both the CLI and the Streamlit setup wizard's boundary upload step.

goals: Define an area of interest (upload the sample AOI GeoJSON) and configure a two-year analysis window
Run NDVI/NDWI/NBR/etc change detection between two time periods and inspect the classified change map and statistics
Generate representative sample points (GeoJSON/CSV) for field verification of detected change patches
Run land-cover classification (multi-index thresholding or GMM clustering) over the AOI and review class statistics
Run pixel-wise time-series trend analysis (Mann-Kendall + Theil-Sen) across multiple years
Export a PDF change-detection report summarizing methodology, results, and sample points

review.summary: The tree accurately records what could be done offline: setup wizard, parameter panels, image fetching, batch queue and the job center, with screens that match. But it leaves out the stages the README presents as the point of the tool (change maps and statistics, field sample points, reports, classification results, trend results, results library), so it needs those added as unreached nodes before filing.
